purpose.zh: Agent 修复当前失败后常直接提交更新，却不检查旧能力和圈外任务是否退化。
purpose.en: Agents often commit an update after fixing the current failure without checking regressions on mastered and out-of-loop tasks.

core_idea.zh: 把每次更新视为带非回退、成本和安全约束的策略改进；仅在隔离回归集通过后 commit，否则 rollback。
core_idea.en: Treat every update as constrained policy improvement; commit only after isolated non-regression, cost, and safety tests, otherwise roll back.

rationale.zh: 每次更新同时包含收益和回退风险；自进化应被写成带非回退、成本和安全约束的策略改进。
rationale.en: Every update carries gain and regression risk; self-evolution should be constrained policy improvement.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“把每次更新视为带非回退、成本和安全约束的策略改进；仅在隔离回归集通过后 commit，否则 rollback。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。

importance.zh: 直接研究 ICLR 关心的学习动力学：哪些更新被接受、为何多轮改进不坍塌、收益能否圈外泛化。
importance.en: This directly studies learning dynamics, multi-round stability, and out-of-loop generalization.

collision_boundary.zh: AFlow 搜索工作流、WebRL 控制策略漂移，但没有统一的跨更新表面 commit/rollback 规则。
collision_boundary.en: AFlow searches workflows and WebRL controls policy drift, but neither provides a unified cross-surface commit/rollback rule.

purpose.zh: 任务成功或重新加入轨迹不等于完整恢复，残余状态可能被写成成功经验。

rationale.zh: Agent 需要学习动作后的状态变化、不可逆后果和恢复边界，但更准的模型不一定改善决策。
rationale.en: Agents need action-conditioned dynamics, irreversible outcomes, and recovery boundaries, yet accuracy may not improve decisions.

finding.zh: 覆盖 3 类任务域。
finding.en: Covers 3 task domains.

finding.zh: 通过证书的工作流应更好迁移到未见工具和任务图。
finding.en: Certified workflows should transfer better to unseen tools and task graphs.

finding.zh: 必须逐轮报告收益、最坏回退和被拒绝更新。
finding.en: Must report gain, worst regression, and rejected updates after every round.

finding.zh: 环境真值、工具执行或异构 Critic 必须提供独立证据。
finding.en: Environment truth, tool execution, or a heterogeneous critic must provide independent evidence.

finding.zh: 上限 1 GPU、16 GPU 小时。
finding.en: Cap: 1 GPUs and 16 GPU-hours.

execution_mode.zh: ICLR 主结果使用开放权重、冻结基础模型和持久小组件更新；视觉专门版本留给 CVPR。
execution_mode.en: ICLR primary results use open weights, frozen backbones, and persistent small-component updates; visual specialization remains for CVPR.

experiment_protocol.critic_or_verifier: Frozen heterogeneous open-weight critic plus environment/tool ground truth whenever available.

commercial_api_role.zh: 仅作为固定版本可选上界或最多 200 次审计 Judge；核心结论不得依赖。
commercial_api_role.en: Optional fixed-version ceiling or audited judge for at most 200 calls; never required for the core claim.

parameter_updates.zh: 只更新 Prompt、记忆、工作流、路由器、Reward 校准器或 <50M 参数模块。
parameter_updates.en: Update prompts, memory, workflows, routers, reward calibrators, or modules below 50M parameters.

discovery.zh: 每个主域 100–200 个训练样本，只确认现象。
discovery.en: Use 100-200 training examples per main domain for phenomenon confirmation only.

calibration.zh: 另取不重叠的 100–200 个样本冻结阈值和至多三组超参数。
calibration.en: Use a disjoint 100-200 examples to freeze thresholds and at most three hyperparameter settings.

test.zh: 官方测试集或至少 500 个隔离样本；测试期间禁止修改更新规则。
test.en: Use official tests or at least 500 isolated examples; update rules stay frozen during testing.

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

setup.zh: 在 WorfBench、HumanEval、HotpotQA 上，以 1 GPU、16 GPU 小时完成两个开放模型和至少两个任务域的 P0/P1/P2 验证。
setup.en: Run P0/P1/P2 on WorfBench, HumanEval, HotpotQA with two open models and at least two domains within 1 GPUs and 16 GPU-hours.

gate.zh: 通过证书的工作流应更好迁移到未见工具和任务图。
gate.en: Certified workflows should transfer better to unseen tools and task graphs.

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若“通过证书的工作流应更好迁移到未见工具和任务图。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
gate.en: Stop if the hypothesis—Certified workflows should transfer better to unseen tools and task graphs.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

controls.zh: 无持久更新，匹配推理预算。
controls.en: No persistent update with matched inference budget.

controls.zh: 全部接受或仅按当前任务收益接受。
controls.en: Accept all updates or filter only by current-task gain.

controls.zh: 固定工作流、Prompt 搜索、AFlow、随机图编辑、贪心修改、等成本 MCTS。
controls.en: Fixed workflows, prompt search, AFlow, random graph edits, greedy edits, and equal-cost MCTS.

controls.zh: 等预算随机更新／拒绝。
controls.en: Equal-budget random update/rejection.

controls.zh: 隐藏真值 Oracle 上界。
controls.en: Hidden-ground-truth oracle ceiling.

repetitions.zh: 三个随机种子；报告均值、标准差和样本级 bootstrap 95% CI。
repetitions.en: Three seeds with mean, standard deviation, and sample-level bootstrap 95% CIs.

call_budget.zh: 记录环境交互、模型调用、token、工具调用、候选更新和被拒绝更新。
call_budget.en: Report environment interactions, model calls, tokens, tool calls, candidate updates, and rejected updates.

compute_budget.zh: 上限 1 GPU、16 GPU 小时、5 天。

main_table.zh: Future-task gain、Worst regression、Update-admission precision、Out-of-loop generalization 与单位交互/调用/GPU 收益。
main_table.en: Future-task gain, worst regression, update-admission precision, out-of-loop generalization, and gain per interaction/call/GPU-hour.

ablations.zh: 移除归因／回归门控。
移除圈外测试。
同架构 Critic 替代异构 Critic。
ablations.en: Replace heterogeneous critic with actor family.

ablations.zh: 不匹配调用与算力预算。

success_gate.zh: 两个开放模型、至少两个任务域均优于最强等预算 baseline，且最坏回退不增加。
success_gate.en: Both open models and at least two domains beat the strongest equal-budget baseline without increasing worst-case regression.

stop_gate.zh: 若“通过证书的工作流应更好迁移到未见工具和任务图。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。

purpose.zh: 固定反思和更新轮数会在简单任务浪费调用，在困难任务过早停止。

core_idea.zh: 学习一个小型元控制器，根据边际收益、分歧、回退和成本选择继续、回滚或停止。
core_idea.en: Learn a small meta-controller that chooses continue, roll back, or stop from marginal gain, disagreement, regression, and cost.

rationale.zh: 每次更新同时包含收益和回退风险；自进化应被写成带非回退、成本和安全约束的策略改进。

comparative_advantage.zh: 相较于“全部接受、仅按当前任务收益接受、置信度门控、固定非回退阈值、等预算随机更新。”，该机制直接检验更新是否产生持久、可归因且稳定的圈外收益。

collision_boundary.zh: 现有 Agent 搜索通常固定预算或 patience，停止规则没有被当作学习对象。
collision_boundary.en: Agent search usually fixes budgets or patience; stopping itself is rarely treated as a learning problem.

gate.zh: 若“半衰期应比 recency/FIFO 更快删除过期记忆并保留长期有效规则。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
gate.en: Stop if the hypothesis—Half-life should remove stale memories faster than recency/FIFO while retaining durable rules.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

controls.zh: 无持久更新，匹配推理预算。
controls.en: No persistent update with matched inference budget.

controls.zh: 全部接受或仅按当前任务收益接受。
controls.en: Accept all updates or filter only by current-task gain.

controls.zh: 无记忆、FIFO、相似度检索、摘要记忆、固定技能库、随机删除。
controls.en: No memory, FIFO, similarity retrieval, summary memory, fixed skill libraries, and random deletion.

controls.zh: 等预算随机更新／拒绝。
controls.en: Equal-budget random update/rejection.

controls.zh: 隐藏真值 Oracle 上界。
controls.en: Hidden-ground-truth oracle ceiling.

repetitions.zh: 三个随机种子；报告均值、标准差和样本级 bootstrap 95% CI。
repetitions.en: Three seeds with mean, standard deviation, and sample-level bootstrap 95% CIs.

call_budget.zh: 记录环境交互、模型调用、token、工具调用、候选更新和被拒绝更新。
call_budget.en: Report environment interactions, model calls, tokens, tool calls, candidate updates, and rejected updates.

compute_budget.zh: 上限 1 GPU、18 GPU 小时、5 天。

main_table.zh: Future-task gain、Worst regression、Update-admission precision、Out-of-loop generalization 与单位交互/调用/GPU 收益。
main_table.en: Future-task gain, worst regression, update-admission precision, out-of-loop generalization, and gain per interaction/call/GPU-hour.

ablations.zh: 移除归因／回归门控。
移除圈外测试。

ablations.en: Replace heterogeneous critic with actor family.

ablations.zh: 不匹配调用与算力预算。

success_gate.zh: 两个开放模型、至少两个任务域均优于最强等预算 baseline，且最坏回退不增加。
success_gate.en: Both open models and at least two domains beat the strongest equal-budget baseline without increasing worst-case regression.

stop_gate.zh: 若“半衰期应比 recency/FIFO 更快删除过期记忆并保留长期有效规则。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
stop_gate.en: Stop if the hypothesis—Half-life should remove stale memories faster than recency/FIFO while retaining durable rules.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

purpose.zh: 平均收益相似的更新可能引发完全不同的行为分布漂移。

core_idea.zh: 用轨迹 KL、动作编辑距离、工具路由和记忆检索变化定义离散 Agent 更新信赖域。
core_idea.en: Define a trust region for discrete agent updates using trajectory KL, action-edit distance, tool routing, and memory-retrieval shift.

rationale.zh: 每次更新同时包含收益和回退风险；自进化应被写成带非回退、成本和安全约束的策略改进。

collision_boundary.zh: 自进化综述按更新表面分类，但跨表面选择仍少有直接学习方法。
collision_boundary.en: Surveys classify update surfaces, but direct learning of cross-surface selection is rare.

hypothesis.zh: 路由器应以明显低于穷举的成本接近 oracle 修复收益。
hypothesis.en: The router should approach oracle repair at substantially lower cost than exhaustive evaluation.

strongest_baseline.zh: 固定工作流、Prompt 搜索、AFlow、随机图编辑、贪心修改、等成本 MCTS。
strongest_baseline.en: Fixed workflows, prompt search, AFlow, random graph edits, greedy edits, and equal-cost MCTS.

pilot.zh: 在 ALFWorld、AgentBench、MM-Vet 上，以 2 GPU、44 GPU 小时完成两个开放模型和至少两个任务域的 P0/P1/P2 验证。
pilot.en: Run P0/P1/P2 on ALFWorld, AgentBench, MM-Vet with two open models and at least two domains within 2 GPUs and 44 GPU-hours.

decisive_metric.zh: Future-task gain、Worst regression、Update-admission precision、Out-of-loop generalization 与单位交互/调用/GPU 收益。
decisive_metric.en: Future-task gain, worst regression, update-admission precision, out-of-loop generalization, and gain per interaction/call/GPU-hour.

stop_condition.zh: 若“路由器应以明显低于穷举的成本接近 oracle 修复收益。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the hypothesis—The router should approach oracle repair at substantially lower cost than exhaustive evaluation.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

budget.training: Freeze the foundation model; update only prompts, memory, workflows, routers, or modules below 50M parameters.

finding.zh: 自进化综述按更新表面分类，但跨表面选择仍少有直接学习方法。
finding.en: Surveys classify update surfaces, but direct learning of cross-surface selection is rare.

finding.zh: ICLR 价值在于学习可组合、可泛化且稳定的结构更新规则。
finding.en: The ICLR contribution is learning compositional, generalizable, stable structure-update rules.

finding.zh: 覆盖 2 类任务域。
finding.en: Covers 2 task domains.

finding.zh: 路由器应以明显低于穷举的成本接近 oracle 修复收益。
finding.en: The router should approach oracle repair at substantially lower cost than exhaustive evaluation.

finding.zh: 必须逐轮报告收益、最坏回退和被拒绝更新。
finding.en: Must report gain, worst regression, and rejected updates after every round.

finding.zh: 环境真值、工具执行或异构 Critic 必须提供独立证据。
finding.en: Environment truth, tool execution, or a heterogeneous critic must provide independent evidence.

finding.zh: 上限 2 GPU、44 GPU 小时。
finding.en: Cap: 2 GPUs and 44 GPU-hours.

execution_mode.zh: ICLR 主结果使用开放权重、冻结基础模型和持久小组件更新；视觉专门版本留给 CVPR。
execution_mode.en: ICLR primary results use open weights, frozen backbones, and persistent small-component updates; visual specialization remains for CVPR.

experiment_protocol.critic_or_verifier: Frozen heterogeneous open-weight critic plus environment/tool ground truth whenever available.

commercial_api_role.zh: 仅作为固定版本可选上界或最多 200 次审计 Judge；核心结论不得依赖。
commercial_api_role.en: Optional fixed-version ceiling or audited judge for at most 200 calls; never required for the core claim.

parameter_updates.zh: 只更新 Prompt、记忆、工作流、路由器、Reward 校准器或 <50M 参数模块。
parameter_updates.en: Update prompts, memory, workflows, routers, reward calibrators, or modules below 50M parameters.

discovery.zh: 每个主域 100–200 个训练样本，只确认现象。
discovery.en: Use 100-200 training examples per main domain for phenomenon confirmation only.

calibration.zh: 另取不重叠的 100–200 个样本冻结阈值和至多三组超参数。
calibration.en: Use a disjoint 100-200 examples to freeze thresholds and at most three hyperparameter settings.

test.zh: 官方测试集或至少 500 个隔离样本；测试期间禁止修改更新规则。
test.en: Use official tests or at least 500 isolated examples; update rules stay frozen during testing.

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

setup.zh: 在 ALFWorld、AgentBench、MM-Vet 上，以 2 GPU、44 GPU 小时完成两个开放模型和至少两个任务域的 P0/P1/P2 验证。
setup.en: Run P0/P1/P2 on ALFWorld, AgentBench, MM-Vet with two open models and at least two domains within 2 GPUs and 44 GPU-hours.

gate.zh: 路由器应以明显低于穷举的成本接近 oracle 修复收益。
gate.en: The router should approach oracle repair at substantially lower cost than exhaustive evaluation.

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若“路由器应以明显低于穷举的成本接近 oracle 修复收益。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
gate.en: Stop if the hypothesis—The router should approach oracle repair at substantially lower cost than exhaustive evaluation.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

controls.zh: 无持久更新，匹配推理预算。
controls.en: No persistent update with matched inference budget.

controls.zh: 全部接受或仅按当前任务收益接受。
controls.en: Accept all updates or filter only by current-task gain.

controls.zh: 固定工作流、Prompt 搜索、AFlow、随机图编辑、贪心修改、等成本 MCTS。
controls.en: Fixed workflows, prompt search, AFlow, random graph edits, greedy edits, and equal-cost MCTS.

controls.zh: 等预算随机更新／拒绝。
controls.en: Equal-budget random update/rejection.

controls.zh: 隐藏真值 Oracle 上界。
controls.en: Hidden-ground-truth oracle ceiling.

repetitions.zh: 三个随机种子；报告均值、标准差和样本级 bootstrap 95% CI。
repetitions.en: Three seeds with mean, standard deviation, and sample-level bootstrap 95% CIs.

call_budget.zh: 记录环境交互、模型调用、token、工具调用、候选更新和被拒绝更新。
call_budget.en: Report environment interactions, model calls, tokens, tool calls, candidate updates, and rejected updates.

compute_budget.zh: 上限 2 GPU、44 GPU 小时、8 天。

main_table.zh: Future-task gain、Worst regression、Update-admission precision、Out-of-loop generalization 与单位交互/调用/GPU 收益。
main_table.en: Future-task gain, worst regression, update-admission precision, out-of-loop generalization, and gain per interaction/call/GPU-hour.

ablations.zh: 移除归因／回归门控。
移除圈外测试。
同架构 Critic 替代异构 Critic。
ablations.en: Replace heterogeneous critic with actor family.

ablations.zh: 不匹配调用与算力预算。

success_gate.zh: 两个开放模型、至少两个任务域均优于最强等预算 baseline，且最坏回退不增加。
success_gate.en: Both open models and at least two domains beat the strongest equal-budget baseline without increasing worst-case regression.

stop_gate.zh: 若“路由器应以明显低于穷举的成本接近 oracle 修复收益。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
stop_gate.en: Stop if the hypothesis—The router should approach oracle repair at substantially lower cost than exhaustive evaluation.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

blocking_reasons: Oracle labels require executing all update surfaces, making supervision close to exhaustive search.

structured_block.finding: Oracle labels require executing all update surfaces, making supervision close to exhaustive search.
structured_block.required_action: Provide partial-feedback or active-query labels substantially cheaper than enumeration.

early_rejected.title: 更大模型做更多反思
early_rejected.reason: 只增加推理计算，不能证明持久学习。

early_rejected.title: 全参数训练 70B 自进化 Agent
early_rejected.reason: 超出低资源约束且机制难归因。

early_rejected.title: 只在自生成任务上提升
仅商业 API 闭环
early_rejected.reason: 不可复现且依赖供应商快照。

early_rejected.title: 固定多轮 Self-Refine
early_rejected.reason: 属于更多采样，不是进化机制。

early_rejected.title: 同模型 Actor 与 Judge 自我确认
early_rejected.reason: 反馈完整性无法独立验证。

early_rejected.title: 从头训练世界模型和策略
early_rejected.reason: 资源高且无法分离贡献。

early_rejected.title: 单一视觉 benchmark 技巧
early_rejected.reason: 保留为 CVPR 后续，不作为 ICLR 主候选。

early_rejected.title: 只做平均准确率的记忆消融
early_rejected.reason: 无法识别有害条目和负迁移。

early_rejected.title: 无隔离划分的在线适应
泛化 Agent 自进化综述
early_rejected.reason: 不是方法或可证伪 benchmark 贡献。

question.zh: 是否获得持久能力，而不是更多推理、检索或重排？
question.en: Is capability persistent rather than extra inference, retrieval, or reranking?

question.zh: 究竟更新了参数、Prompt、记忆、工作流、Reward 还是世界模型？
question.en: What exactly changes: weights, prompts, memory, workflows, rewards, or world models?

question.zh: 更新能否归因到具体失败、状态或反馈？
question.en: Can the update be attributed to a specific failure, state, or feedback signal?

question.zh: 多轮进化是否避免回退、坍塌与遗忘？
question.en: Does multi-round evolution avoid regression, collapse, and forgetting?

question.zh: 收益能否迁移到未见任务、环境、工具和模型族？
question.en: Do gains transfer to unseen tasks, environments, tools, and model families?

question.zh: Reward、Critic 与 Verifier 是否有独立真值和对抗测试？
question.en: Are rewards, critics, and verifiers independently calibrated and stress-tested?

question.zh: 交互、token、调用、训练与墙钟预算是否严格匹配？
question.en: Are interaction, token, call, training, and wall-clock budgets matched?
